threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one customer firm's client documents to another
likelihood_basis: EV-070 (shared database with row-level security; isolation tests every release); EV-083 (tenant isolation design)
regulatory_driver: Customer contracts; state third-party agent laws
existing_controls: Isolation tests every release; per-tenant keys
treatment_plan: Independent isolation test; isolation regression suite

threat_event: The AI document intake feature runs without SOC 2, sub-processor, contract, and IRC 7216 updates

treatment_plan: System description update; sub-processor notice; customer information pack for IRC 7216; contract amendments
